BRS2-KC1.review_scope: §4 Emerging Biological Supports: creatine, SAMe and named methyl-cycle adjuncts. Core Nutritional Requirements and PM mappings were not reopened.
accepted_limitations: Creatine suppression of endogenous synthesis has not been shown to redistribute methyl resources to other pathways in humans.
SAMe plasma exposure does not establish intracellular or tissue-specific methylation benefit, and long-term safety evidence is limited.
The riboflavin SAM response is based on a small MTHFR 677TT genotype-selected intervention.

BRS2-FM3-PM7.review_scope: Four decisions: KC1/KC2 applicability and Choline/Phosphatidylcholine provision. Not expert or phenome review. KC1/constituent disclosure implementation, documented-example execution and browser verification completed; KC2 and phenome follow-ups remain open. Clarified input-trigger/origin-tag presentation and shared interaction verification completed; scientific records unchanged. Evidence qualification/independent principal selection implemented: Diet-Supported retained, PM7 principal selection not established. 78 live tests passed; existing scientific records preserved. Browser/build verification remains pending.
accepted_limitations: Conditional animal evidence; tracer enrichment is not absolute flux. No universal donor limitation, human intake target or cognitive benefit is established.
No human trial, numeric deficiency threshold or single end-to-end assay is required. Indirect dietary outcomes and genetic perturbation do not yet resolve exposure attribution.
Plasma tracing does not measure absolute hepatic flux, intermediary SAM, ordinary-food equivalence or benefit.

BRS3-FM2-PM3.review_scope: Source check of Houghton 2016, Verlaet 2018, Costa 2026, Riedl 2009, and Wise 2016 for food versus supplement classification, vitamin C, zinc, selenium, dominance, and the repeated-exposure sentence. The 2019 Mocchegiani and Malavolta chapter was not retrieved in full. This is not expert review.
accepted_limitations: The admitted practice is a three-day myrosinase-completed broccoli sprout homogenate and nasal enzyme RNA, not brain Nrf2 or an ordinary broccoli serving.
A four-week broccoli-sprout extract capsule did not raise lung Nrf2 target-gene expression in COPD.
